name: Health Indicator
description: Shows health above nearby living entities.

name: Hit Range
description: Draws a ring showing how far a player can reach with an attack.

name: Shield Status
description: Highlights shields as they raise, block or recover.

name: Fullbright
description: Brightens dark areas using gamma or night vision.

name: Fly Speed
description: Adjusts flight speed when the player can already fly.

name: Freelook
description: Lets players look around without turning their character.

name: Stretched Res
description: Stretches the world horizontally while keeping the HUD at its normal size.
